content: तर्जनम्, -ना [तर्ज्-भावे ल्युट्] .²1 Threatening, frightening. .²2 Censuring; अङ्गुलीकिसलयाग्रतर्जनम् <ls>R. 19. 17</ls>; <ls>Ku. 6. 45</ls>. .²3 Pointing at (in ridicule or contempt.) .²4 Putting to shame, excelling, surpassing. .²5 Anger. .{@-नी@} The fore-finger; विलोक्य भ्रामयामास यमाज्ञामिव तर्जनीम् <ls>Ks. 17. 88</ls>.
